'''Military Police officers''', or '''MPs''', are members of the [[Military Police Corps]] who appear in the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]].

==Background==
These MPs were assigned to act as security for a Defense Contractors' Summit hosted by [[RobCo Industries]] at the [[Lucky 38]] in [[New Vegas|Las Vegas]], [[Nevada]] in 2077.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Wrangler]]===
They can be seen around the entrance of the Lucky 38 as [[The Ghoul|Cooper]] and [[Barb Howard]] arrive. One is seen holding back a group of protestors; when one protestor calls out Cooper for "selling them out," he is hauled away by two MPs. A short while later, two MPs throw [[Diane Welch|Congresswoman Diane Welch]] out of the casino for protesting, which briefly causes a scene when she falls down the steps because of the MPs' manhandling.

Later on, after Cooper's meeting with [[Robert House]], MPs are seen escorting another man out of the Lucky 38.

==Appearances==
Military Police officers appear only {{In|FOTV}} [[Fallout TV series episodes|episode]] "[[The Wrangler]]."

'''Moldaver's elite guards''' are two [[New California Republic]] soldiers under personal command of [[Lee Moldaver]] {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
These two guards are [[New California Republic]] soldiers. In [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]], they are stationed at the [[Griffith Observatory]] under the command of [[Lee Moldaver]], who leads the NCR forces in the [[Los Angeles]] region.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The End (episode)|The End]]===
Led by [[Lee Moldaver]], together with [[Vault 32 raider|a group of raiders]], they infiltrated [[Vault 32]] (whose original inhabitants had died by this point) from the outside circa [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]]. Disguised as Vault 32 dwellers, they entered [[Vault 33]] during the Triennial Trade. 

While the raiders wreaked havoc in the Vault, Moldaver and her guards took several hostages, with the guards holding them at gunpoint. After Moldaver accomplished her objective (kidnapping the Vault 33 overseer, [[Hank MacLean]]), she left with her elite guards and a few of the raiders.

'''Monty''' is a [[Vault 32 raider|raider]] {{In|FOTV}}. In [[Timeline#2296|2296]], he infiltrated [[Vault 33]], posing as a dweller of [[Vault 32]].

==Background==
===Post-War===
Monty was one of [[Lee Moldaver|Moldaver]]'s raiders, during their invasion and occupation of [[Vault 32]]. He posed as a Vault 32 resident and was the "breeder" in the Vaults' Triennial Trade in 2296.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The End (episode)|The End]]===
[[File:FOTV wedding.png|thumb|left|270px|Lucy and Monty's wedding]]
Monty was the choice for [[Vault 32]]'s Triennial Trade with [[Vault 33]], being the "breeder" exchanged for farming equipment from Vault 33. He was married to [[Lucy MacLean]] as part of [[Lee Moldaver|Moldaver]]'s infiltration of Vault 33 and ate with Lucy and [[Steph Harper]] during the wedding banquet. During the banquet, Lucy asked him about his sperm count; Monty did not understand her, but Steph moved the conversation away, interpreting Monty's silence as due to the awkwardness of the question.
